title: Morel Ropes The Fastest Chimera Ant With A Trick That Took 5 Hours

cuts.raw_narration: On a wide grassy plain, Cheetu — a lanky cheetah-spotted Chimera Ant — is perched on top of Morel, a huge pipe-smoking Hunter in sunglasses who is lying flat on his back pretending to sleep. Cheetu cackles that he knew Morel was faking, and vows to keep pestering him until Morel gets up and chases him.

Without even opening his eyes, Morel calls Cheetu an idiot: if he wanted to be chased, he should have set the rules of his own game to force people to chase him. From a distance, Morel's teammate notes on a monitor that Cheetu's new Nen ability still needs work. Morel props his head on his giant golden pipe and tells Cheetu to do whatever he wants — he is not getting up for the next five hours.

Five hours later, the last grains of sand fall through a giant hourglass on the plain and Cheetu is howling with laughter, convinced he has won. Morel stands up, unhurried, and asks if he isn't getting anxious — because Cheetu hasn't noticed it isn't time to begin. It's already over. Morel tells him to look at his own ankle. The camera tilts down: a thin pink smoke rope is tied snugly around Cheetu's foot.

Morel casually explains that this rope of smoke took a lot of work — he had to go all the way around the field while Cheetu was distracted so he wouldn't notice. Overhead diagrams trace the enormous tangled loop Cheetu's own five hours of racing carved into the plain, showing Morel snagged him from the very start. Morel says all that's left is to reel it in, and the smoke cord begins winding back into his pipe.

As Cheetu thrashes against the rope, Morel tells him flatly, "I'm not your enemy here — you're your own worst enemy." Cornered, Cheetu screws his eyes shut and forces a brand-new Nen ability into being on the spot.

In a flash of light, Cheetu unveils his masterpiece: a purple, skull-motif crossbow. Morel stares at him deadpan and asks in disbelief, "A bow? Are you sure you want to come closer now? Why in the hell would you want a power that's so much slower than you are?" The fastest Chimera Ant on the field has voluntarily given himself a weapon slower than his own legs.

Morel then points at the purple claw gauntlet on Cheetu's other arm and tells him to just try the claws already — it'll save Morel the trouble of walking over. Cheetu snarls and demands to know how he could possibly lose. Morel answers plainly, "Because you're an idiot." Cheetu blurs forward and slashes Morel across the back — but the "Morel" he just hit doesn't bleed. Under his claws the body dissolves into a puff of pink smoke.

The real Morel calmly steps out from a nearby patch of "grass" that had been smoke camouflage the whole time. He explains that while Cheetu was reading his manga and cackling to himself, Morel had already made a smoke clone of himself, hid his true body under smoke shaped like grass, and sent the decoy one way while he crept the other. Sleeping, he adds, doesn't mean the fight just stops.

Morel asks if Cheetu still wants to fight. Standing on the rain-soaked rooftop, Cheetu scratches his head, shrugs and admits, "No way, I'm done" — the fastest fighter in the room beaten by a rope he never even noticed.
